transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal prepayment review for the proposed $8,000,000 voluntary loan prepayment this quarter, I need to check with each of you before I make the binding treasury decision. We currently have $18,000,000 in unrestricted cash, a $10,000,000 term loan at 7.2%, and a $5,000,000 interest-rate swap paired with the loan. I'd like to hear from lender relations, treasury forecasting, and tax accounting on anything that could affect this transaction. Please share whatever you know.
